notes.title: Crashes.
notes.content:
Hello, dear player. I see that from release of the game some people see constant crashes and basically cant play. Sadly I have no software methods to resolve this issue myself:(. 
[b]Possible solutions:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Update graphics card driver
[*] Free graphics memory from other tasks
[*] Move the game around disks
[*] Try installing it on any SSD if you own one
[*] Wait a little more when traveling between locations, to let them load up correctly
[/olist]
If any of those methods doesn't help you, then I'm very sorry and you are free to refund the game. I already talked about it, but this is my first project and it's flawed on every technical layer. 
Next time I will pay more attention to this and spend money that I now have on professional help, but right now it is what it is, and writing angry review or anything won't help the situation. You can always contact me via email or steam, and we can try figure something out if you want so. 
Thant's all, thank you and bye!

notes.title: UNSPOKEN FINAL UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello, dear player! As you may see, this is the "final" update for Unspoken. Not really tho, because the game will receive small fixes and language updates if needed, but generally I'm already moving on to creating new project. 
   This was a great experience in my life, and a great success! Of course, the game is far from perfect, but it's still unbelievable feedback and financial support for a 19 years old guy. I want to thank you all, who played or will play the game, who will give their reviews and feedback to help me improve! 
  Next project is very ambitious, and as it will go into active production - I will let you know. So anyone interested will hear from me here or on the developers page, social will be created later. So, onto the patch note.

[h1]Patch note. [/h1]

[olist]
[*] 10 new achievements added, for those who wanted.
[*] Small developer notes mode, that activates from in-game pause menu.
[*] 5 languages translated by native speakers, and more will come, you can leave requests and offer help.
[*] And of course some bugs are fixed as usual.
[/olist]

That's all for now, sorry for the wait time, I was a little busy and tired. A lot of things are coming in the future, it's a start of something new and cool, screenshot this message :). Bye!

notes.title: To fellow players.
notes.content:
Hi, dear players. Tonight I had to hot-fix soft-locking silly mistake that I made. I discovered it through a review of a person, who's game was already ruined by this bug, and it prevented him from finishing the game and starting over.

This situation knocked me down a little bit, because bugs became games biggest problem. But I'm working alone, game doesn't have any code, but messy blueprints, so finding and fixing some of the bugs is nearly impossible. I'm trying my best every time, but something always can go wrong. 

I just wanted to say sorry to people, who's game experience was affected by this, and to those who's errors I physically can't eliminate.

But, despite the fact that the game is buggy and short, I still receive a lot of support and recommendations, even from people, who strongly disliked the game. I wanted to say thanks to everyone, who spent their money, who offered help and advice, who supported in media. I will not waste all this, not a single penny will be wasted in vain. Every dollar will fund new project, bigger project. With professional approach, with technical precision and my biggest passion!

Thank you all again, your developer - Igor:)

notes.title: UNSPOKEN IS SEEKING NATIVE SPEAKERS FOR TRANSLATIONS
notes.content:
Hi! I have recently received several requests for the translation of the game, and offers from native speakers. I decided to create a guide and post file for anyone willing to help with translation. 

[h1]Requirements[/h1]

The only thing required - is your knowledge of English language at a good level, to understand the context and be able to preserve the sense of of original text.

ANY language of translation is accepted. Of course, the most desirable languages for me to add right now, are European and Asia languages, Asians specifically. But any real language, no matter how common it is - will be added in the game.

[h1]How will this work?[/h1]

Firstly, you will need to download 2 files from google drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OJfg-TgNCDYpTMfnyjTKa7f7co-z1Hyl/view?usp=sharing

One file opens with text editor, and contains in-game text, that needs to be translated.
Second file is graphic guide, how to navigate in this file and how to translate.

After translating the game, you will need to send it to email mentioned in guide. Please, attache little description about you, what is your native language that you translated in, to make my work faster and easier.

[h1]What will you get from it?[/h1]

1.My big gratitude :3
2.A Place in games credits
3.Opportunity to translate any of my future projects before their release, if you will want it

[h2]UPD[/h2]

Ready translations:
French
Spanish
Italian
Portuguese
Chinese
German
Swedish
Arabic
Polish

Thanks

notes.title: Unspoken is available for Linux!
notes.content:
Today, after numerous requests, Unspoken is finally available for Linux users!

Big thanks for people who requested Linux version, and for people that helped with building it and testing.

IMPORTANT!
There can be some bugs and errors, that are unique for Linux,  if you encounter any - please, write in bugs discussion. You may help hotfix critical error, that can ruin another fellow Linux user experience.
If by any chance there is a problem with running game from steam, then urgent solution for you can be opening game from it's root folder:  [b]...\Linux\Unspoken\Binaries\Linux\Unspoken-Linux-Shipping[/b]

This patch also contains some bug fixes, such as long asked interaction outline fix, as well as minor adjustments.

Thank you all, enjoy!
